newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian companies see signs of demand upturn - Isco.
newsitem.headline: Italian companies see signs of demand upturn - Isco.

text.p: Italian companies were slightly more optimistic of demand picking up in coming months, a state economic research body said after surveying a sample group of industrial firms at the beginning of September.

"Contrasting with the continuing low levels of demand and output, there is an improvement in expectations...which could foreshadow a halt in the coming months to the current regressive phase," Isco said in its latest report.

It added that the companies polled were hoping to see "greater dynamism" in orders and a "limited recovery" in production in the last months of this year. There seemed to be "more an air of confidence among firms about prospects of the demand trend," it added.
But Isco said that while an improvement in orders was discounted, companies forecast for the last quarter "only a moderate improvement" in demand. -- Rome newsroom +392 6129589
